stages.name: purpose
stages.purpose: Define what the proposed structure would do and what success means.
stages.gate: Purpose, success criteria, site mode, lifecycle use and trigger facts stated; library pinned or declared as a draft.

stages.name: strategic_feasibility
stages.purpose: Obtain or produce the feasibility record at the required depth. Executed by the feasibility module.
stages.gate: Proceed if the human accepts the justification at the required depth. If rejected, stop. If explicitly exploratory, continue with project_status = exploratory.

stages.name: constraint_screen
stages.purpose: Screen every candidate site for show-stopping constraints before context, function or geometry. Runs once per site candidate.

gate.any_conditional: candidate continues; every condition becomes an explicit constraint
gate.any_unresolved: candidate blocked from geometry unless project_status = exploratory
gate.any_prohibited: candidate dropped, unless the human requests a rezoning, variance or mitigation scenario
gate.no_candidate_survives: stop; return to S00 via FB7 with the screen records

stages.name: actors
stages.purpose: Identify who or what uses, moves through, loads, services, or interacts with the structure.
stages.gate: At least one actor; every actor type exists in the domain library.

stages.name: context
stages.purpose: Describe where the structure exists and the external conditions that constrain it.
stages.gate: Required context known or explicitly assumed.

stages.name: scenarios
stages.purpose: Define operating states, design events, and phases the structure must function in or survive.
stages.gate: Every capacity and physics rule references at least one scenario.

stages.name: functions
stages.purpose: Define what activities and processes the structure must host.
stages.gate: Every referenced unit, zone, role, group, and implicit function is declared; every zone is contained by exactly one unit.

stages.name: capacity
stages.purpose: Quantify demand, size, throughput, occupancy, loading, and other required capacities.
stages.gate: Minimum demand is feasible within any stated global size or capacity budget.

stages.name: relations
stages.purpose: Define how units, actors, systems, flows, and context entities connect, separate, support, and interact.
stages.gate: All relation endpoints declared; no hard contradictions.

stages.name: physics_and_regulation
stages.purpose: Compile physical actions, governing models, codes, safety rules, and site-specific approval conditions.
stages.gate: Every rule is sourced, scenario-aware where applicable, and has a declared evaluable stage.

stages.name: performance
stages.purpose: Define what qualities should be optimized among otherwise valid candidates.
stages.gate: Scoring weights sum to 1.0; every score group has a metric or soft rule.

stages.name: semantic_model
stages.purpose: Assemble the complete pre-topology model and detect conflicts before form generation.
stages.gate: No unresolved hard conflicts; no unknown required for topology.

stages.name: topology_generation
stages.purpose: Generate structurally distinct organizational candidates without continuous coordinates.
stages.gate: At least the library minimum number of diverse valid candidates.

stages.name: topology_validation
stages.purpose: Validate every candidate against topology-stage hard rules.
stages.gate: At least one valid topology.

stages.name: geometry_generation
stages.purpose: Create dimensioned geometric realizations from valid topologies.
stages.gate: Each realization passes all geometry-stage hard rules.

stages.name: system_sizing
stages.purpose: Size selected systems against all scenarios.
stages.gate: System capacities and physical flows close or are explicitly flagged.

stages.name: elements
stages.purpose: Derive physical elements from geometry and systems.
stages.gate: No orphan element.

stages.name: independent_validation
stages.purpose: Independently test all hard constraints and scenario-dependent rules.
stages.gate: Any failed hard rule rejects the candidate.

stages.name: scoring
stages.purpose: Rank surviving candidates against soft performance, strategic value, and human priorities.
stages.gate: Scores trace to metrics/rules; multiple diverse valid candidates remain where possible.

stages.name: human_acceptance
stages.purpose: Require explicit human choice before deliverable export.
stages.gate: Explicit acceptance.

stages.name: export
stages.purpose: Produce the requested deliverable with full provenance.
stages.gate: Deliverable includes provenance and feasibility status.
